purpose: Teach: 東南アジア/四国/採取/タンパク質/探査/単身/誤差/交易

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、本気で、絶対、東南アジア、絶対、密輸、絶対、組織、絶対、捜査しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: The police are conducting a serious, thorough investigation into the smuggling organization operating throughout Southeast Asia.
lines.style: Measured, official tone. Clear enunciation on key terms. Steady pace, no inflection—the cadence of someone delivering facts. Professional warmth underneath, not rushed.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、本気で、絶対、四国、絶対、警察、絶対、合同捜査、絶対、進められたんですね、本気で、感謝
lines.en: So the investigation into this case has been progressing as a joint effort between the Shikoku and national police forces?
lines.style: Genuine curiosity, respectful. Slight upward inflection at the end. Leaning forward slightly in posture. Eager to understand without pushing. Warm but deferential.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: はい。証拠の、本気で、絶対、採取、絶対、警察、絶対、徹底しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. The police have been extremely rigorous in collecting and preserving evidence from the scene.
lines.style: Affirmative and direct. Crisp attack on 'Yes.' Even delivery, professional. Emphasize 'rigorous' with quiet confidence—not defensive, just factual.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、本気で、絶対、薬物、絶対、タンパク質、絶対、分析、絶対、警察、絶対、進められたんですね、本気で、感謝
lines.en: I see. So the analysis of the drug and protein compounds has been moving forward as part of the investigation?
lines.style: Thoughtful pause before speaking. Measured pace. Genuine interest in the technical detail. Slight rise at the end—a question, not a statement. Respectful of the process.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、本気で、絶対、行方不明者の、絶対、探査、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: The police are actively pursuing leads on the missing person as part of the ongoing operation.
lines.style: Formal but not cold. Steady rhythm. Emphasis on 'actively pursuing'—shows commitment without drama. Composed, like reading from careful notes.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、本気で、絶対、容疑者の、絶対、単身、絶対、行動、絶対、警察、絶対、追跡しているんですね、本気で、感謝
lines.en: So you're tracking the suspect's movements and whereabouts individually as part of the case?
lines.style: Quiet intellectual engagement. Slower pace—processing as he speaks. Soft on the question mark. Not pressing for detail, just confirming his understanding.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、本気で、絶対、目撃証言の、絶対、誤差、絶対、慎重に、絶対、確認しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're carefully reviewing witness statements and accounting for any possible discrepancies in their accounts.
lines.style: Calm, procedural. Slight emphasis on 'carefully'—signals precision and thoroughness. Even tone. The voice of someone who knows this work matters.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、本気で、絶対、不正、絶対、交易、絶対、警察、絶対、摘発、絶対、されたそうですね、本気で、感謝
lines.en: I understand. So the illegal trading network has been dismantled through the police department's efforts?
lines.style: Reflective conclusion. Slow, appreciative pace. Almost quiet—absorbing the weight of what's been done. Respectful, slightly relieved. Trailing slightly on the final word.
